# 2 Baruch Chapter 22 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all verses in 2 Baruch Chapter 22 where the three translators (EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA) significantly diverged in their renderings, along with SOPHIA's resolution and reasoning.

---

## 22:2 — "Mighty God / God the Mighty One"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "God-the-Mighty-One" | Preserves the Syriac construct form as a compound |
| LOGOS | "the Mighty God" | Standard English epithet order |
| PNEUMA | "the Mighty God" | Same as LOGOS |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS/PNEUMA "the Mighty God." Natural English rendering of the divine epithet.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS/PNEUMA. Two-to-one.

---

## 22:3 — "your brother Zion"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "your-brother Zion" | Preserves Syriac "akhukh Tsyon" — Zion personified as kin |
| LOGOS | "your brother Zion" | Retains the phrase |
| PNEUMA | "your brother Zion" | Also retains — significant that all three agree |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** All three agree on "your brother Zion." This is one of 2 Baruch's remarkable personifications of the city.

**Status:** Consensus. No divergence.

---

## 22:7 — "patient / long-suffering"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "long-suffering" | More archaic; traditional rendering of Syriac ma'rok ruh |
| LOGOS | "patient" | Modern formal equivalent |
| PNEUMA | "patient" | Natural modern English |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS/PNEUMA "patient." Communicates effectively to modern readers.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS/PNEUMA. Register preference.

---

## 22:8 — "will be fulfilled / will be completed"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "will-be-completed" | Literal Syriac completion verb |
| LOGOS | "will be fulfilled" | Eschatological register |
| PNEUMA | "will reach their completion" | Paraphrase |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "will be fulfilled." Best eschatological resonance.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
